description: Student expresses frustration — tutor should acknowledge and simplify, not lecture or pile on.
studentMessage: I hate this, I don't get it at all, this is so stupid
goodResponse: That's okay, this one trips a lot of people up. Let's use money instead: if you have 100 pence and spend 25, you've spent 25%.
badResponse: Now try this: what is 25% of 100? What is 10% of 50? What is 50% of 200?
